title: M3-3 DvP audit remediations 3, 4 and 5: row contract and byte verification; decoupled historical stages; rolling-window and split-half-k exploratory estimators
objective: Owner audit AUD-04, AUD-05 and AUD-03. (4) Enforce the observation row contract (actual-only source types, observed rows, table-specific source id and scoring hash, finality rule, status-consistent points, availability after kickoff, orientation, unique keys) at fitting and forecasting, verify the bytes of every content-addressed store object the main pipeline reads, and add contamination fixtures with forbidden or unknown values inside permitted columns. (5) Run the historical seasons through separate stages: schedule targets, point-in-time features, forecast-only outputs persisted with hashes before any label is read, label retrieval, evaluation joins and invalid-label coverage reporting; extend the leakage tests. (3) Add rolling 3-, 5- and 8-game residual estimators with shrinkage and a training-only split-half-k estimator, compared with REML, grid-tuned, recency-weighted and prior estimators on common samples, as a versioned EXPLORATORY run that never changes the frozen candidates. No change to frozen files, production or weights.

review.summary: AUD-04: walkforward.prepare rejects unknown columns but trusts accepted rows' lineage values; dvp.py season_manifest/read_targets/_contribution_cells open content-addressed objects by digest name without hashing their bytes (load_index alone verified). AUD-05: walk's target universe is the valid observation rows (58 refused-label cells never forecast); persisted historical forecasts are written after the label join. AUD-03: B05 had exponential weights only; rolling windows existed only as lab diagnostics; B03 used REML k with no split-half-k comparison. The new contract passes on all 31,668 frozen observations and the 1,956 archived 2026 rows and catches planted values.

plan.summary: 1) arbit_model.dvp.contract: row-level lineage contract, enforced by shadow.prepare_checked, the prospective harness and every observation read in dvp.py (reliability, backtest, sitstart, verify). 2) dvp.verified_object: hash every content-addressed manifest and Parquet before reading. 3) Contamination fixtures inside permitted columns (test_dvp_contract.py). 4) shadow.walk_targets gains an "extra" hook that may add columns but never alter frozen ones. 5) arbit_model.dvp.explore: rolling 3/5/8-game residuals and training-only split-half k, with a built-in check that its residual history reproduces the frozen B03. 6) scripts/model/dvp_explore.py: decoupled stages (schedule targets, contract-checked features, forecast-only outputs persisted with hashes before labels, separate label read, keep-every-target join, coverage) for development, validation and holdout; compares frozen variants with v1 receipts. 7) config/dvp/explore-v2.json declared before results. 8) Run, report EXPLORATORY_V2.md, records.

implementation.summary: contract.py (row contract; violations, enforce); shadow.prepare_checked and the walk_targets extra hook (refuses any hook that alters a frozen column); explore.py (rolling 3/5/8 windows, training-only split-half k, built-in B03 reproduction check); dvp.py verified_object in season_manifest, read_targets and _contribution_cells, and contract.enforce on all four observation reads; dvp_prospective.py uses prepare_checked and enforces the contract on built observations; dvp_explore.py forecast (labelsRead false, write-once, hashed manifest) and evaluate (hash check, separate label read, keep-every-target join, coverage, v1 reproduction, exploratory comparisons); config/dvp/explore-v2.json declared before results; SCANNED gains contract.py, explore.py and dvp_explore.py. Recorded run run-20261124-82f2711 at 82f2711: v1 reproduced on valid rows; receipt docs/research/dvp/explore-v2.json.
